note: Manually updated by Claude after each workflow run/notification — not a live meter. Real usage report gives a combined token count, not a separate input/output split, so cost is shown as a range based on plausible split assumptions. Entries from 2026-08-22 onward are computed from each workflow run's actual per-agent token usage (real input/output/cache-read/cache-write counts, Sonnet-class pricing) rather than an assumed split, so those rows show a single precise figure (low=high) instead of a range. One RAG Atlas batch (Module 08 Concepts 03-05) is still running as of this update and will be added once it finishes.
